# Meriq

> Meriq is the AI export operator for Taiwanese manufacturers and exporters. It turns an overseas buyer inquiry into a shippable export plan: a structured export RFQ, forwarder freight quotes normalized into one comparable table, a preliminary duty and landed-cost estimate, an export document checklist, destination-country risk questions, and a reply summary ready to send back to the buyer. AI organizes the work first; people verify it. Meriq coordinates — the customer's own forwarders and customs brokers still execute carriage and filing, and final HS classification and duty rates are always confirmed by licensed professionals.

## What Meriq does
- Structures a vague buyer inquiry (email, spec sheets, quantities, destination) into a complete export RFQ: origin/destination, Incoterms, cargo dimensions and weight, FCL / LCL / air / courier recommendation, special-cargo flags, target ship date.
- Requests quotes from partner freight forwarders and normalizes them into one table: freight, local charges, destination charges, transit time, free time, and whether customs clearance is included.
- Estimates landed cost per order: product price, international freight, insurance, duties, clearance fees, destination charges — so exporters know whether the margin holds before quoting.
- Assembles the export document checklist (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, B/L or AWB, Certificate of Origin, MSDS, spec sheets) and flags what is missing and who to ask.
- Prepares the next steps: a buyer-ready reply summary, an RFQ package for forwarders, confirmation questions for the customs broker, and a pre-shipment checklist.

## Who it is for
Taiwanese manufacturers, exporters, and trading companies with overseas inquiries — industrial components, bicycles and outdoor gear, auto parts, hardware and tooling, electronics, and Kickstarter / Amazon / Shopify shipping teams.

## How it works
1. Submit one overseas inquiry at https://meriqai.com/zh-TW/export-plan (or /en/export-plan) — incomplete details are fine; Meriq lists what is missing.
2. AI structures the costs, documents, and logistics options; the Meriq team verifies with partner forwarders, brokers, or specialists.
3. Within one business day the exporter receives an export plan they can send to their buyer.

## Pricing
Early access: a free check of one real inquiry, then a one-off Export Desk Pilot. Monthly plans are available for teams with a steady flow of overseas inquiries.
